items.name: Lensing crossover: robust EFC ≈ flat (near-GR); the z ≈ 0.44 crossover is fragile
items.efc_value: ≈ flat in z (robust; η→1 ⇒ Σ≈μ≈0.99, near-GR, monotonic, no crossover). Sign change at z ≈ 0.44 is fragile (η-dependent, 0% robust per 32037990)
items.claim: The non-monotonic Σ_eff(z) crossover at z ≈ 0.44 (enhancement at z < 0.4, suppression at z > 0.5) requires Σ > 1 at low z — which comes from the gravitational-slip boost η ∈ [1.05, 1.15], classified 0% robust (fragile) by EFC's own perturbation-sector analysis (DOI 32037990). The robust EFC (η→1; slip terms ε_λ, ε_K cancel under screening) gives Σ≈μ≈0.99 flat in z ⇒ no crossover (near-GR, monotonic). This profile is absent in ΛCDM and in standard QS Horndeski models with α_T=0.
items.test: Euclid DR1 tomographic cosmic shear (4+ z-bins, Oct 21, 2026)
items.falsifier: A monotonic Σ_eff(z) across all bins with no sign change inside z ∈ [0.3, 0.6] kills only the fragile (η-boosted) crossover branch — a monotonic result is consistent with the robust EFC prediction (Σ≈μ≈0.99 flat, near-GR).
items.source_evidence: evidence/05_results.md R8; robustness per DOI 32037990 (η ∈ [1.05,1.15] = 0% robust)

items.name: fσ8(z=0.7) = 0.430
items.claim: The regime-transition growth model predicts fσ8(z=0.7) = 0.430 vs ΛCDM 0.449. Joint BAO distance prediction: D_H/r_d(z=0.7) = 19.797 vs 20.719; D_H/r_d(z=1.0) = 16.527 vs 17.466. As of 2026-04-26, the α-parameter underlying P2 is independently constrained to α ∈ [−0.72, −0.68] via non-MCMC BAO+Growth+Cluster analysis (DOI 32101213).
items.test: DESI DR2 full-shape RSD at z ~ 0.5-0.7 (release pending 2026)
items.falsifier: Measured fσ8(z=0.7) > 0.449 at > 3σ — i.e. consistent with ΛCDM at high significance — damages but does not kill EFC (point prediction, not structural).

items.name: E_G: robust EFC ≈ 1 (no enhancement); 1.086 enhancement is fragile
items.efc_value: ≈1 (robust; η→1 ⇒ Σ=μ≈0.99<1 ⇒ no enhancement). 1.086 ± 0.012 at k_c ≈ 0.05 h/Mpc is fragile (η-dependent, 0% robust per 32037990)
items.claim: Galaxy-CMB-lensing cross-correlation combined with RSD produces the gravitational slip estimator E_G. The E_G enhancement E_G^EFC/E_G^GR = 1.086 ± 0.012 at k_c ≈ 0.05 h/Mpc and z_eff ≈ 0.5 rests on the gravitational-slip boost η ∈ [1.05, 1.15], which EFC's own perturbation-sector robustness analysis (DOI 32037990) classifies as 0% robust (fragile). The robust EFC prediction (η→1; slip terms ε_λ, ε_K cancel under cosmological screening) gives Σ=μ≈0.99<1 ⇒ E_G≈1 (no enhancement). The robust prediction does NOT require E_G>1.
items.test: Simons Observatory CMB lensing × Euclid DR2 galaxy catalogue (~2027-2028)
items.falsifier: Measurement = 1.00 ± 0.01 at > 3σ (GR recovery) would falsify the fragile enhancement, but is consistent with the robust E_G≈1 prediction.
items.pass_window_note: Fragile (η-dependent) pass window; the robust prediction is E_G≈1.
items.source_evidence: DOI 32023788, sealed 15 Apr 2026 with SHA-256 falsifier; robustness per DOI 32037990 (η ∈ [1.05,1.15] = 0% robust)

items.name: Cosmic shear S8 ≈ 0.82 (robust, shifted downward)
items.claim: Derivation result, not data-fit: the robust EFC growth sector gives Σ=μ(1+η)/2 with η→1 ⇒ Σ≈0.99<1, so S8 shifts slightly downward to S8≈0.82 (DOI 31188193: 'S8 shift downward… consistent with the S8 tension'). The earlier S8 = 0.847 ± 0.015 value (cosmic shear ξ_+ enhancement of ~8% at angular scales 20'-300', requiring Σ ∈ [1.03,1.07]) depended on the η ∈ [1.05,1.15] boost = 0% robust/fragile. New canonical: S8≈0.82 (robust, down). vs DES Y6 0.789 (~1-1.5σ), KiDS-Legacy 0.815 (<0.5σ) ⇒ PASS/mild. Discriminates EFC from f(R) (which predicts μ > 1) and from background-only entropic gravity models. Also testable via the formal RCMP DES Y6 + KiDS Legacy protocol (DOI 32080083, 2026-04-22).
items.test: Rubin LSST DP2 (Jul-Sep 2026); DES Y6 + KiDS Legacy via RCMP (2026)
items.falsifier: DP2 + Euclid DR1 combined return S8 consistent with Planck ΛCDM (0.811 ± 0.006) at < 1σ — EFC loses its primary motivation.
items.source_evidence: DOI 32013738 (sealed); S8-direction per DOI 31188193 (robust downward shift); DOI 32080083 (RCMP test spec, 2026-04-22); DOI 32084670 (coupling-structure closure)

items.name: Horndeski no-go: robust EFC does not exclude Horndeski
items.efc_value: EFC reaches the forbidden (μ < 1 ∧ Σ > 1) quadrant only via the fragile η-boost (η-dependent, 0% robust per 32037990). Robust EFC has Σ≈μ<1, outside the forbidden quadrant — does not exclude Horndeski
items.claim: Standard quasi-static Horndeski with α_T=0 and c_s² > 0 cannot produce μ < 1 and Σ > 1 simultaneously — the action forces Σ ≤ μ universally. EFC was claimed to break this only by reaching the forbidden (μ < 1, Σ > 1) quadrant, which requires the gravitational-slip boost η > 1 (the Σ > 1 piece) — classified 0% robust (fragile) per DOI 32037990. The robust EFC has Σ≈μ<1 (both suppressed, η→1), so it does NOT occupy the forbidden quadrant and does NOT exclude Horndeski.
items.test: Full numerical scan of (α_B, α_M) parameter space (done, 135,000 points; 0 Horndeski solutions vs 15 EFC solutions — the 15 EFC solutions all sit in the fragile η-boosted region)
items.falsifier: Doubly-conditional: EFC distinguishes itself from Horndeski only via the fragile η-boost. The earlier 'if P1+P3 are confirmed ⇒ standard Horndeski is excluded' wording is now doubly-conditional — both P1 and P3 are fragile/η-dependent, so the exclusion holds only if both fragile branches survive Stage-IV.
items.source_evidence: evidence/05_results.md R9, DOI 32037990 Result 1; robustness per same DOI (η-boost = 0% robust)

items.name: Background sign lemma
items.claim: ΔE²(z) ≤ 0 for all z > 0, i.e. H_EFC(z) ≤ H_ΛCDM(z). Reduced Hubble friction enhances growth; analytically proven (Lemma 1) and numerically verified at A ∈ {0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 5.0}.
items.falsifier: A counterexample at any z > 0 with A in the tested range would falsify the lemma. Analytical proof currently closed.

items.name: H0 three-window decomposition
items.efc_value: Triple-null test: non-null predicted in all three windows. H0_L0 ≈ 67.5, H0_L1 ≈ 69.5, H0_L2 ≈ 73.5 is an interpretive mapping, not the paper's decomposition
items.claim: The Hubble tension is not a free-parameter degeneracy but a regime-mismatch artefact. EFC predicts that Planck (L0 background), DESI BAO (L1 transition), and SH0ES (L2 perturbation) measure H0 in distinct regime windows that do NOT need to coincide. The three-window decomposition (thermal/geometric/structural redshift) is a synthesis of existing EFC results, not a new derivation; the projection P_ξ is specified to first order only. The H0 triplet is an interpretive mapping, not the paper's decomposition. Atlas role upgraded 2026-04-29 from addresses_open to proposes_resolution.
items.test: Joint regime-disaggregated chain on Planck + DESI DR2 BAO + SH0ES + Euclid DR1 shear (three-window decomposition per DOI 32113399).
items.falsifier: Triple-null test: EFC predicts a non-null signal in all three windows; a triple-null result consistent with ΛCDM in every window is a clean falsification.
items.source_evidence: DOI 32113399 (2026-04-28), a synthesis of existing EFC results (not a new derivation); supports atlas role-upgrade EFC → H0_tension proposes_resolution

items.name: A falsified bar-instability criterion reveals an independent disk-state parameter
items.efc_value: Π_min falsified as a bar predictor (AUC=0.217, anti-correlated, captures 0/12 bars, N=43 SPARC); retained as an independent disk-state parameter (ρ[Π,logΣ]=−0.71, ρ[Π,f_gas]=+0.65, n=112)
items.lcdm_value: Efstathiou-Lake-Negroponte (ELN) criterion: ε_ELN = V_max/√(GM_d/R_d) > 1.1 implies bar instability
items.claim: EFC's Π bar-criterion Π_EFC = σ_R·κ_eff/(3.36·G·Σ) < 1 (κ_eff incorporates the entropy-gradient correction) was tested on N=43 SPARC galaxies and is FALSIFIED as a bar predictor: AUC=0.217 (anti-correlated), capturing 0/12 bars. Π_min is retained NOT as a bar predictor but as an independent disk-state parameter (ρ[Π,logΣ]=−0.71, ρ[Π,f_gas]=+0.65, n=112).
items.test: Cross-population test against SPARC (N=43 with the bar label; 175 in the rotation-curve sample), S4G (~2300), Galaxy Zoo bar-fractions; protocol pre-registered as vc_140e79363cbe.
items.falsifier: Falsified: AUC=0.217 (anti-correlated, 0/12 bars captured) on N=43 SPARC rejects Π as a bar predictor.
items.source_evidence: DOI 32101111 (2026-04-26), 'A Falsified Bar-Instability Criterion Reveals an Independent Disk-State Parameter'
